description: Shared parity fixture for the DCR swing-phase widget (issue #4535). Reproduces the governed equal-instantaneous-DCR, different-reachable-width counterexample from tests/test_dcr_event_sensitivity_protocol.py::test_state_dependent_drift_breaks_any_dcr_to_reachable_width_mapping. Both tests/test_dcr_visualizer_parity.py and tests/dcr-visualizer.test.js read this file so the two runtimes are checked against one set of numbers.
